version: Dopahar village plan, 1 Nov 2026 (second edit). This replaces every earlier layout file.
frame: metres, 1 unit = 1 m, +x east, +z south, origin near the village square. Relative positions are the point; the whole layout may be shifted as one piece to sit in the existing world.
rules: No dead ends: every road, lane and farm track joins another at both ends. Front paths (3 to 6 m) are doorsteps only.
Village square is a slow zone for vehicles.
Highway ends are the world edge, with a To the city board at each end.
Back lanes are walking and cycles only (posts at each mouth).
Every building faces the lane its front touches; a compound wall stands behind any back that faces a street or open ground.
